prompt: rust repr packed struct nested repr align member restriction
answer:
A `#[repr(packed)]` struct cannot transitively contain a struct with `#[repr(align)]`. Also, `#[repr(packed)]` and `#[repr(align)]` cannot be applied to the same type.

The reverse is allowed: a `#[repr(align)]` struct may contain a `#[repr(packed)]` struct.
